title: The Little Star Who Lost Her Twinkle
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A little star whose light is soft and steady discovers that kindness makes her light shine brighter than any twinkle in the sky.
long_description: Twilla is a little star whose light is soft and steady. She longs to twinkle like all the other stars. When she helps a lost bat find his way home, Twilla discovers a wonderful secret: kindness makes your light shine brighter than any twinkle in the sky. A gentle bedtime story about friendship, kindness, and helping others.
moral_lesson: Kindness and helping others make your own light shine the brightest.
